title: One clause parser reads a sentence's subject, verb and object, so claim checks stop reading word windows
why: Three checks hit the limit of word windows on Nov 8. #1812's cannot-claim guard: its returning false alarms are notes whose fix is "follow-up 3's class design" (coordinator, 04:31 CST). The comment-narration check: history inside a real gloss cannot be told from a rule quote (debt under comment-narration-limits, coordinator 05:17 CST). The pre-existing guard: #1935 narrows to the incident form, with debts for cause nouns, rare base words, modifier words, an earlier denial and "bug fails" (coordinator, 05:28 CST).
note: Fix: one home, a clause parser that reads each clause's subject, verb and object (follow-up 3's class design on #1812), called by lint/report_guard.py's cannot-claim and pre-existing checks and by lint/check_comment_narration.py; each user's debts close as its red cases go green. Debts that point here: the #1935 pe-* debts (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run), the narration history-inside-gloss debt (lane comment-check-scans-shell), and #1812's follow-up notes. Filed 05:31 CST Nov 8. Doing in lane cannot-claim-needs-tries as follow-up 3 on #1812, in its round 2 (coordinator, 05:29 CST Nov 8). Slices (lane cannot-claim-needs-tries, coordinator 05:39 CST Nov 8): A, the parser in lint/_clause.py with cannot-claim as first caller and no verdict change, from follow-up 3's head in this lane; B, the pre-existing check (report_guard's `_claims_pre_existing`, #1935 / pe-guard-narrow) in lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run once #1935 lands; C, the comment-narration gloss in lane comment-check-scans-shell once its stack lands. The five #1935 pe-* debts are built on #1935 at e6aff647e (in its fix check), each with `Fix: step:clause-parser-claims` (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 05:39 CST). Scope add (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 05:46 CST Nov 8, found by #1935's fix check): "Lint fails too, on main." and "Lint fails as well, on main." pass today. Lane's follow-up 3 is draft #1950 (Merge after: #1891), partly done for this step; follow-up 4, slice A, has no PR yet and starts from #1950's final head (lane, 05:54 CST Nov 8). Slice A is #2058, a draft that merges after #1950; review round 1 is running. #1950 is ready and with runner 8 (lane cannot-claim-needs-tries, session_013NEJL4AtAVhGNb2poKhrsi, 08:43 CST Nov 8).
